concept.dir: Showroom-as-library: material cards with grain photography, a species and finish comparison tool, sample-request flow, and a project index. Warm paper, wood-texture rules, honest error-free chrome.
interactive: Material swatch grid with hover grain detail
Project index with rooms and years
concept.refs: A wood merchant catalogue for homeowners.

web.note: Audited live: pages still served from a temp-domains path (box5292.temp.domains/~dgfloorc), the title tag reads Hardwood Fooring Contractors, a nav item reads Many Opions, and uploads date to 2015. It is a real business on a half-dead server.
